subject: Edge Serving + Runtime team alignment — proposed structure, timelines, and comms
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@talentco.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Edge Serving + Runtime team alignment — proposed structure, timelines, and comms

Team —

Attached is a first-pass proposal to align Edge Serving (currently split across two squads) with the Runtime team so we have a single product/operational owner for inference infrastructure. High-level goal: reduce operational duplication, simplify SLAs we expose to customers, and create clearer career ladders for infra engineers.

Key points in the doc (org_one-pager.pdf):
- Proposed structure: two pods under Runtime (Serving Pod, K/V + Cache Pod) with a single Runtime manager.
- Role scope changes: move model-serving infra ownership (deploy/monitor/runbooks) from Edge squad; retain Edge team for SDKs, device integration.
- Timeline: planning & HR alignment (Jul 15–Aug 2), manager-level announcements (Aug 3), team-level comms + 1:1s (Aug 4–Aug 14), full transition window by Sep 30.
- Risks: short-term velocity hit, headcount mismatch for SRE coverage — model attached capacity scenarios.

Asks:
1) Please review the one-pager and comp_matrix.xlsx and flag anything you cannot sign up for by EOD Tuesday (Jul 20).
2) Monica — can you confirm constraints on changes that overlap the promotion/comp cycle?
3) Lauren/Markus — any objections to the proposed manager consolidation? If yes, call it out with alternatives.

I included Olivia from TalentCo for an early read on comms templates and redundancy planning.

Attachments: org_one-pager.pdf (one-pager v1), comp_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@talentco.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge Serving + Runtime team alignment — proposed structure, timelines, and comms

Thanks — quick notes after skimming:
- I support a single Runtime manager, but we should explicitly preserve the Senior IC lane for career growth (do not remove principal role path).
- Can we clarify headcount movement (who backfills Edge-facing gaps)? The comp_matrix shows level changes but not backfill timing.
- Suggest we pilot manager consolidation on a small group (2 teams) first and run a canary comms to a single affected team before org-wide announcements.

I'll add inline comments on the PDF. Would like a manager talking-points doc (2 slides) and a list of 1:1 prompts for managers to use. If we move manager announcements to Aug 3, that gives teams enough time for 1:1 scheduling.

On comp alignment: defer to Monica — we shouldn't change role levels until we align comp cycles.

-Lauren
VP, Product Operations

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@talentco.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge Serving + Runtime team alignment — proposed structure, timelines, and comms

Appreciate the thoughtfulness here. A couple of operational flags:
- Capacity: the model assumes we can reallocate two SRE FTEs from Edge into Runtime with minimal ramp. In reality, those engineers are on a set of customer-facing SLAs and holiday coverage. I've attached a quick capacity model (team_capacity_model.csv) to show the 8–12 week ramp we should budget.
- Hiring: If we are moving responsibilities, we should agree who owns the open reqs for platform reliability. We should either reassign req ownership or open immediate backfill reqs to avoid gaps.
- Metrics: propose we define the acceptance criteria for transfer success (error budget, deploy latency, customer incident count) for the pilot cluster.

Operationally I'd prefer a staged move (canary pod + one additional pod), not a full swap on Sep 30. Otherwise, I risk service degradation.

-Markus
Head of Reliability Engineering

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@talentco.com>, Ruth Connor <ruth.connor@legalpartners.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge Serving + Runtime team alignment — proposed structure, timelines, and comms

Thanks for the early visibility — a few HR/legal notes before we lock timelines:
1) Compensation & promotions: Any level/role scope changes that affect current or near-term promotions need to be queued with Compensation. The comp_matrix.xlsx is a good start, but I need the list of affected employees (by role) to map to the upcoming comp cycle. Without that, we should not make level changes effective until after the next review window (mid-Sep).
2) Consultation: We typically run a 2-week consultation period with managers and impacted ICs for material role changes. That means our earliest public manager announcement should be Aug 3 only if managers have received the manager talking-points and a list of impacted people by Aug 1.
3) Legal review: Ruth — cc'd — please flag any employment-law constraints for the EU-headcount distribution if we shift people between reporting lines across regions.

I've attached the comp_guidelines.pdf for reference. Also opened ticket HR-TKT-4821 (link below) to track approvals.

Action items for Hannah: please provide an anonymized roster (role + location) for the affected 12 roles so HR can map compensation impact. Also: draft manager talking points and a short FAQ for 1:1s.

Best,
Monica Patel
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai

Thanks for the feedback — updated materials attached (org_one-pager_v2.pdf contains Laure's note about preserving the Senior IC lane and Markus's staging request).

Planned next steps (final ask list):
- Hannah: share anonymized roster by Mon Jul 20 (ACTION — I'll send CSV).
- Monica: confirm whether manager announcement can go Aug 3 conditional on HR ticket progress (HR-TKT-4821).
- Lauren/Markus: approve pilot canary plan (I propose ServPod-1 as pilot) by Wed Jul 22.
- Olivia: provide a manager talking-points template + template email for affected teams by Jul 21.

Comms embargo: please hold public comms until Aug 3. Managers will have a 48–72 hour window to schedule 1:1s after that date.

Attachments: org_one-pager_v2.pdf, team_capacity_model.csv (updated)

I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the pilot acceptance criteria and timeline — calendar invite forthcoming.

Thanks all,
Hannah
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
